purpose: Freeze the released measured forcing and initial-condition assumptions before candidate model selection. Candidate-specific constitutive assumptions are deliberately not supplied here.
sprayStatus: No independently quantified event spray history is available in the reviewed report. Do not derive spray flow from the held-out pressure curve. A new spray-capable component is not evidence that a particular spray schedule occurred.
geometryAndCapacityPolicy: Preserve the v0.10 generic primary, secondary and pressurizer volumes and fuel capacity for the initial paired physics comparison. Their event-era applicability remains unidentified; changing these assumptions cannot be hidden inside a pressure-formulation comparison.
initializationPolicy: Use published initial values and the existing initial-only flow, conductance and feedwater-enthalpy constructions. New phase or wall states require a separately disclosed, pre-scoring initialization assumption. No transient response is an initialization input.
candidateConfigurationStatus: Not selected in this ledger; a separate candidate configuration must identify equations, new parameters, source basis and sensitivity cases before scoring.
claimBoundary: This is development on an already observed event. Numeric improvement cannot establish full-startup or full-scope plant validation.
